book.name: EPESO
book.title: Epeso wali Leta Pol wana Leleli

content: Komiu Yehoba natunau nunuwanil, inoke nuku labose nuku ola iya.
Nunuwana paganina eliyana nuku nanawaa, ni ola te Keliso i nunuwana-agila. He iya yawalina i talamwan kila kaiwela i ola powon bwalena waiwaisana toto Yehoba i yaliyaya-an.
Neganega paganina ge pagan pulupuluwawena, ge tomemek paganina, bahi kekeisi etega ni gagan eliyamiu. Pagan bolo ona o komiu Yehoba wana gamagalau bwabwalel nige bosowaimiu i oola.
I ola al, bahi ba sigasiga, bahi ba bwagabwaga hot, bahi neganega talawasena nuku babaunan, kaiwena nige i wawaisa eliyamiu. He ba mulolu Yehoba elana te nuku baunan.

Nuwamiu ni sapu te bolo neganega paganina ge pagan pulupuluwawena hi awaawaginol, ge bolo hi tomemek nige abaliya ni gagan Keliso ge Yehoba wali abaloguguiya. (He tomemek paganina i ola te ta kukululuek yabowaine kakakawena elana.)
Inoke bahi gamagal etega wana ba kakakawi eliyana nuwamiu ni liliwan ahe. He pagan bolo ona o kaiweliya Yehoba wana huga i nenem gamagalau bolo anana nige hi hahago eliyalil.
Inoke bahi alomiyau ge gamagalau ololal o nuku lolopapalagito.
Valila ku minaa gogouwa, yaa sauga ya Babala eliyana ku minaa mwananala. Inoke yawalimiu ana nawanawa ni ola komiu mwananal natunau,
ge nuku loyaan hauna toto Babala i yaliyaya-an nuku atena. Kaiwena mwananal enowana heiya pagan waiwaisana, pagan sasapona ge ba tunahot.
Bahi nuku nonoek gogou paganina ana ginol elal, kaiwena nige enona i gagan, yaa nuku teli pamasalil mwananala ge gamagalau nihi atena gegi to.
(He toto gamagalau hi ginol sume nige bosowaiu na gotalisi-an, ana baaba ya puluwawi-an.)
Bugul gegewel bolo ta teli pamasalil mwananala, yaka gamwaliya hot ta kite bubun,
kaiwena mwananal te bugul gegewena i teli tagilagil ge ta kite bubun. Heiya te kaiwena wala baaba etega i ba:
He yawalimiu ana nawanawa nuku matahikan bubun. Nuku ola bolo tonuwasapu, bahi nuku oola bolo nige nuwaliya i sasapu.
Bahi wami sauga waiwaisana etega nuku hahanavenu-an, kaiwena sauga toto ya nak ana awaawaginol iyaka i gasisi.
Bahi nuku sigasiga, yaa Babala wana nuwatu kaiwemiu nuku atena bubun.
Bahi wewel gasigasisena nuku im kokona-an, eba ni apapanak-agimiu. Yaa Yayaluwa Bwabwalena nuku kalaopopwi.
Same, wona tapwalolo ge wona bolo Yayaluwa Bwabwalena wana pewa ali baaba nuku baubaunan alomiyau elal. Awamiwa ge atemiwa al ge nuku wona tobal Babala elana,
ge wala Babala Yeisu Keliso alana elana, sauga gegewena nuku ba mulolu Yehoba Tamala elana bugul gegewena kaiweliya.
Toalolon Meluyowau ge Melubolau Baliya
Alomiyau wali logugui nuku henapuan Keliso ana awatauwan kaiwena.
Komiu toalolon meluyowau, lagomiyau wali logugui nuku henapuan ni ola Babala wana logugui ku henapuan.
Kaiwena tau iya lagona kaununa i ola te Keliso iya ekelesiya kaununa. He ekelesiya iya Keliso tuwana, ge Keliso iya ekelesiya ana Topwamwal.
Ekelesiya Keliso wana logugui i henapuan, he i ola al to toalolon meluyowau lagoliyau wali logugui nihi henapuan sauga gegewena.
Komiu toalolon melubolau, lagomiyau nuku nunuwana-agil ni ola Keliso ekelesiya i nunuwana-an ge yawalina i talamwan kaiwena.
Yawalina i talamwan nuwana toabulilek ni ul payanayana-agil wewel elana
ni ola Wasa Waiwaisana ana baaba. Keliso nuwana ekelesiya ni pwabwabwalena,
ge ni pamilil matanaa ni ola ekelesiya toto ana awa waiwaisana hot, nige ana potpot, nige tuwana i lolobabanunu, ge nige nakina etega al, yaa i sapusapu ge nige wana gegi i gagan.
Inoke i ola al, bolau lagoliyau nihi nunuwana-agil ni ola heliya tuwaliya gabomwina ona hi nunuwana-agil. Ebo tau lagona ni nunuwana-an, he i ola totona i nunuwana-an to.
He nige sauga etega gamagal etega totona tuwana i pipihigelgel-an. Yaa ni paan ge ni matahikan bubun, ni ola Keliso i ginol kila ekelesiya elala,
kaiwena kila iya tuwana gabomwina ona.
Buki Bwabwalena i ba, “Heiya kaiwena tau tamana ge hinana ni miluwagil ni na alona ge lagona nihi mipamaisena inoke ali toto labui nihi ola tuwan maisena.”
Buki ya ana nuwatu i limwan hot. He nau ya liwan pwatanek Keliso alona ge ekelesiya elal.
Yaa ana baaba i noewa al komiu eliyamiu. Inoke tau maisena ge maisena lagona ni nunuwana-an ni ola totona i nunuwana-an, ge yova lagona ni awatauwan.

footnotes.text: He “wewel elana” ba kakanun etega babitaiso bana.
